history.administration_response: The Administration stated that the 2011 enterprise risk management policy was under revision, with finalization anticipated in the second quarter of 2025. Consultations with relevant stakeholders is ongoing. The updated policy is intended to clarify the roles and responsibilities of the first and second lines of defence, including the specific functions of the Department of Peace Operations. Once completed, the revised policy will be presented to the Management Committee for endorsement. Once the revised policy is endorsed, specific language will be highlighted in the fifteenth progress report of the Secretary- General on accountability, in 2025.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes the progress made and will be attentive to the completion and implementation of the revised enterprise risk management policy.
